source.description: Reviewed handmade raster marker-process contact sheet, cropped only after the full six-panel sequence was approved.
source.notes: One cheerful non-face hamburger with two steam curls; no lettering, arrows, UI, signatures, or watermarks.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels move from a sparse bun-and-stack scaffold to bun silhouette, fillings, sesame and steam, ink/color map, then a finishing-only marker pass.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one bun dome arc, two horizontal stack guides, a patty oval, and two steam route ticks.

anchor_map.early_mark: One high dome arc over two horizontal stack guides
anchor_map.becomes: The top bun over the centered hamburger stack
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The dome stays centered above the fillings and the two guides retain the top and bottom bun spacing.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open pale construction routes only; the closed bun contour is absent until Panel 2.

anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The patty remains centered between the cheese and lower bun, extending slightly beyond both buns at the same left and right points.
anchor_map.construction_note: An allowed pale closed ellipse used solely to teach the patty proportion.

anchor_map.early_mark: Two tiny upper steam route ticks
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Each wisp rises from the same top-bun positions without moving or becoming a new prop.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open pale routes only; complete steam curls first appear in Panel 4.

final_elements.name: bun scaffold and silhouette
final_elements.description: One rounded sesame top bun and one lower bun framing a centered burger.

final_elements.name: patty cheese and lettuce
final_elements.description: One brown patty, one draped yellow cheese slice, and one wavy green lettuce strip between the buns.

final_elements.name: sesame and steam
final_elements.description: Six sesame seeds and exactly two rising steam wisps above the top bun.

final_elements.name: marker palette
final_elements.description: Thick black outlines plus tan buns, brown patty, yellow cheese, green lettuce, and a small warm-red tomato accent.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The bun guides remain open around the filling stack so no keeper bun line must be erased when the fillings appear.

frames.visible_job: Place one open dome arc, two horizontal bun-spacing guides, one pale patty oval, and two tiny steam route ticks.
must_not_show: cheese lettuce tomato sesame or full steam curls

frames.visible_job: Draw only the rounded top bun and lower bun directly over the stack guides, leaving fillings, seeds, steam, black ink, and color absent.
must_not_show: cheese lettuce tomato sesame or full steam curls

frames.visible_job: Turn the established patty ellipse into one patty, then add one draped cheese slice, one wavy lettuce strip, and one narrow tomato accent between the fixed buns.
must_not_show: sesame seeds or full steam curls

frames.visible_job: Add exactly six sesame seeds on the established top bun and turn the two route ticks into two rising steam curls.
Ink only established contours, then map tan, brown, yellow, green, and warm-red marker strokes in every planned region.
adds: one thick imperfect black keeper-line pass
must_not_show: new fillings steam seeds face lettering or props

final_step.visible_job: Only complete established marker fills, reinforce selected keeper contours, and add small existing highlight and shadow accents.

rejection_checks: Reject a first panel with closed buns, visible fillings, sesame, steam curls, black ink, or color.
Reject a sheet where filling spacing or steam origins shift, or where a later panel only traces prior geometry darker.
Reject clean vector-like icons, polished poster art, or any final feature absent from an earlier panel.
